verdict.rationale: Hatchet has a public first-party GitHub repository (hatchet-dev/hatchet) that describes the orchestration engine, and its self-hosting docs describe running the control plane yourself, which indicates the source is readable. However, no evidence names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache) in the evidence, and confirmation that the full control-plane source is in the repo.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: An orchestration engine for background tasks, AI agents, and durable workflows
Hatchet is a platform for orchestrating background tasks, AI agents, and durable workflows at scale. It supports applications written in Python, TypeScript, Go and Ruby
Self-hosting Hatchet means running your own instance of the **Hatchet Control Plane**
